answer: A payout is split so that 43% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The delta schedule is applied in inlet and atlas shows each instalment. An copycat hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1163 identities would post 2797 proofs and burn roughly 3 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
